method: Editorial tier (1 most direct, 4 least direct) and kind added to existing groups. No Quran text was added or changed in this batch, so no Quran MCP call was needed; the passages are the ones already verified in the earlier batches of this app.

tierScale.1: most direct: the terms are plainly named in one reading
tierScale.2: direct, but across several ayat or in less familiar wording
tierScale.3: needs a careful read of the passage or familiarity with Arabic names
tierScale.4: least direct: wording, Arabic roots or cross-passage knowledge needed
